title: マイルCSの後に・夢は何度でも！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: RAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap refuses to lose, and Bamboo Memory refuses to be beat! Who will emerge victorious from today's deadlocked race?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (I gotta give it all I got and set this place on fire! Burn it up, burn it up, burn it up! I've gotta lay down everything I've got…)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: AND BUUUUURN BRIIIIGHT!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory has broken ahead! Bamboo Memory is in the lead! She's keeping it, and…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Yes! Bamboo Memory crosses the finish line first! Give it up for Bamboo Memory, the Ruler of the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoooooa! That was unbelievable! Look, I've got goosebumps! Bamboo Memory's out of this world!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I can't believe she beat Oguri! She was supposed to be invincible!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: She did it. She put on a race so brilliant it pierced my soul.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: She really did! Talk about heart-pounding! She makes me want to have a race just like that someday!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That which seemed set it in stone has crumbled today. Unexplored territory lies ahead—truly, this is the dawn of a new era.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The passion… the energy…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That was… awesome.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to do this again. I want to make our next race even better.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And of course, I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's my dream now.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course! I would looove to have a race even better than today! In fact, I have to now!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Good. Then I'll look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Traineeeer! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Seriously! Thank you, thank you, thank you, and—one more time—thank yooooouuu!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My dream finally came true!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But I'm not done yet! I'm gonna keep chasing new dreams forever and ever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So, please… Would you…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heck yeah! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right, there's just one last thing we gotta do to commemorate this moment! Ready?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: BAMBOOOOO! MEMORYYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Emerging victorious from her red-hot rivalry with Oguri Cap, Bamboo Memory takes her rightful place as this generation's Ruler of the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A short while later…

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "Continuing with the latest Twinkle Series news, there's one sweltering race everyone's been talking about! That's right, it's the Mile Championship!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "Now, that was a race for the history books! That's not to say last year's battle with Tamamo Cross or the showdown between the Eternal Top Three a few days ago weren't incredible…"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "But Bamboo Memory has certainly proven herself to be synonymous with mile races!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "And I think we got a clear picture of just how huge a presence Bamboo is for Oguri!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "I agree! My heart was still pounding well after the race was over. I even found myself raving about it to my daughter. She's still just a young Umamusume, but…"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "She told me she wants to run in a race just like it one day. I'm tearing up just remembering how her eyes were shining when she said that. She's found such a fantastic dream."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: She found a dream…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's great! I'm so happy to hear that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But I'm not through yet! The dreams of our generation are just starting to heat up! Things're gonna get way hotter from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We're going to keep blowing people's minds with even more incredible showdowns!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: OHHH MAN! Just saying it is getting me fired uuuup!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's what I'm talking about!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory and I sprint toward a brand new future and the incredible races that await!
